title: Phone Pouch
description: A snug crochet sleeve for your phone. Quick to make and endlessly customisable with stripes.
expectationText: A practical beginner project where you crochet a simple rectangle, fold and seam it, and add a flap. Perfect for using up leftover yarn.

steps.title: Measure your phone
steps.instruction: Lay your phone flat and measure its width. Your starting chain needs to be slightly wider than the phone.

steps.title: Start the body
steps.instruction: Chain enough stitches to cover the phone width plus 1 extra. Single crochet into the second chain from hook and each chain across. Chain 1 and turn.

steps.title: Build the panel
steps.instruction: Single crochet across each row until the piece is just over twice the phone height. Keep your tension even.

steps.title: Fold and seam
steps.instruction: Fold the piece with the right side facing in. Single crochet or slip stitch the side seams together.

steps.title: Make the flap
steps.instruction: On the back piece only, single crochet across the top for 4 rows to create a flap that folds over the front.

steps.title: Add closure
steps.instruction: Sew a button on the front. Make a small chain loop on the flap to fit around the button. Weave in all ends.
